items.title: Zay Flowers: Runs on side Wednesday
items.description:
Flowers (lower body) did not participate in Wednesday's practice, but he did run sprints on the side, Jamison Hensley of ESPN.com reports.

items.title: Jonathon Brooks: Optimism for Week 1
items.description:
Coach Dave Canales said Wednesday he's "very optimistic" Brooks (soreness) will be available for Week 1 against the Bears, Sheena Quick of Fox Sports Radio 1340 reports.

items.title: Ashton Jeanty: Optimism for Week 1
items.description:
